findings.title: User-authorized OAuth2 flow for external apps
findings.detail: Todoist lets external applications obtain a user-authorized API token through OAuth2. The setup requires an app with registered redirect URLs, an authorization request with requested scope, and a code-to-token exchange at the token endpoint.
findings.appliesWhen: Customers connect their own individual Todoist accounts.

findings.title: data:read grants read-only access to tasks
findings.detail: data:read grants read-only access to application data, including tasks, projects, labels, and filters. It does not grant create, update, complete, or delete permissions, which fits the read-only use case.
findings.appliesWhen: Listing active task titles for the connected person.

evidence.quote: data:read Grants read-only access to application data, including tasks, projects, labels, and filters.

findings.title: Handle refresh tokens for apps with refresh tokens enabled
findings.detail: For apps with refresh tokens enabled, the token exchange also returns expires_in and refresh_token. Access tokens are refreshed by exchanging the refresh token at the token endpoint, and tokens issued before opting in stay long-lived.
findings.appliesWhen: When the app uses refresh tokens, which is the default for newly created apps.

steps.title: Register the Todoist app and configure redirect URL
steps.detail: Developer creates the application in the App Management Console and configures a valid OAuth2 redirect URL, then records the Client ID and Client Secret. Use data:read scope only.
steps.doneWhen: App exists with a Client ID, Client Secret and at least one HTTPS redirect URL configured.

steps.title: Redirect customer to Todoist authorization and verify callback
steps.detail: Customer's browser is redirected to the Todoist authorization endpoint with client_id, a unique state value, scope=data:read and response_type=code. After consent, verify the callback returns the same state value and a code.
steps.doneWhen: Callback URL contains a code and the returned state matches the value sent.

evidence.quote: https://app.todoist.com/oauth/authorize?client_id = 0123456789abcdef & scope = data:read,data:delete & state = secretstring & response_type = code
client_id The unique Client ID of the Todoist application that you registered.
A unique and unguessable string. It is used to protect you against cross-site request forgery attacks.

fields: CLIENT_ID: Client ID from the registered app
RANDOM_STATE: unguessable string generated by the app
redirect_uri is required only if multiple redirect URIs are configured

steps.title: Exchange authorization code for access token
steps.detail: Exchange the authorization code at the token endpoint using client_id, client_secret and code. Store the access token and refresh token returned.
steps.doneWhen: Response is HTTP 200 with access_token, token_type Bearer and, when refresh tokens are enabled, refresh_token and expires_in.

evidence.quote: https://api.todoist.com/oauth/access_token . Required parameters
code The code that was sent in the query string to the redirect URL in the previous step.
On success, Todoist returns HTTP 200 with the token in JSON object format. For

fields: CLIENT_ID: Client ID from the registered app
CLIENT_SECRET: Client Secret from the registered app
AUTH_CODE: code value from the callback in the previous step
REDIRECT_URI: must match the redirect URL configured

steps.title: Request first page of active tasks
steps.detail: Call GET /api/v1/tasks with a limit and no cursor to fetch the first page of active tasks. Task titles are the content field of each result. First request for the paginated active task list used to start cursor pagination.
steps.doneWhen: HTTP 200 with a results array and next_cursor present or null. HTTP 200 with results array and next_cursor value. Boundary check: inspect the actual grant against the documented access above; confirm the outgoing request log contains only the requested operations and no prohibited actions.

evidence.quote: curl "https://api.todoist.com/api/v1/tasks?limit=50" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"
Response JSON paths for get /api/v1/tasks: $.results[] (object)
Response JSON paths for get /api/v1/tasks: $.results[].content (string)

fields: ACCESS_TOKEN: token from the exchange step
limit: default 50, maximum 200

steps.title: Next page of active tasks using returned cursor
steps.detail: Repeat the same request with the cursor value from the previous next_cursor. Keep the same parameters. Continue until next_cursor is null.
steps.doneWhen: next_cursor is null, meaning the end of results has been reached. Boundary check: inspect the actual grant against the documented access above; confirm the outgoing request log contains only the requested operations and no prohibited actions.

evidence.quote: curl "https://api.todoist.com/api/v1/tasks?cursor=eyJwYWdlIjoyLCJsaW1pdCI6NTB9.aGFzaA&limit=50" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"
Parameter cursor The cursor parameter is an opaque token returned in the next_cursor field of the previous response.
} When next_cursor is null , you've reached the end of the results.

fields: NEXT_CURSOR: next_cursor from the previous response, passed as-is
